note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a LIT 18; A06b LIT 18; L05 LIT 24(2), 26(2)): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another (with exceptions). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generally applicable provision), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, with no further limit on a child born abroad. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file. On 2026-11-03 the primary was read: Constitution of the Republic of Lithuania (English text), Seimas of the Republic of Lithuania, art. 12. It confirmed renunciation and loss on taking another citizenship. It was silent on the years of residence, birth in the territory and descent, which still rest on the sources above, re-read that day and found the same. The Constitution confirms them only in principle (no dual citizenship save the cases the law provides); the Law on Citizenship wasn't reached.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Lithuania, 2024
sources.said: Person has legally resided in Lithuania for the last 10 years and has the right of permanent residence. ... Renunciation or automatic loss of citizenship of another country. ... Person acquires citizenship of another country (there are exceptions). Person should inform Lithuania within 2 months of acquisition of citizenship of the other country). ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Lithuania to a citizen. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born abroad to a citizen. ... No provision ... No provision

sources.title: Constitution of the Republic of Lithuania (English text), Seimas of the Republic of Lithuania, art. 12
sources.said: Article 12 Citizenship of the Republic of Lithuania shall be acquired by birth or on other grounds established by law. With the exception of individual cases provided for by law, no one may be a citizen of both the Republic of Lithuania and another state at the same time. The procedure for the acquisition and loss of citizenship shall be established by law.
